alternative: Unequal read depth between region classes
prediction: Heterozygotes are missed more often where coverage is lower, by a different amount in each worm, biasing diversity in eliminated regions
test: Reads thinned before genotype calling so that every worm has the same expected depth in both region classes
result: Before thinning, eliminated regions were covered at 64% to 112% of retained depth (median 78%); after thinning, 13× in every worm, eliminated-to-retained ratio 0.998 to 1.003

alternative: Duplications present in these worms but collapsed in the reference
prediction: Fixed differences between paralogous copies are called as heterozygous sites, inflating diversity where such duplications are common
test: Variant sites screened on heterozygous allele balance
result: The screen removed 13.4% of eliminated and 2.3% of retained variant sites (5.9-fold); excluding dense local variant clusters as well raises the contrast from 1.88- to 2.16-fold

alternative: Reduced effective population size (Ne) in eliminated regions
prediction: Lower neutral diversity and less efficient selection raise πN/πS without any change in the constraint on the genes
test: Eliminated windows compared with retained windows of matched fourfold diversity (π0/π4); split-half validation across window sizes
result: πS is threefold lower in eliminated genes (0.00316 versus 0.00993); at matched π4, π0/π4 is 1.44-fold higher in eliminated windows (95% CI 1.06 to 2.00; 9 versus 13 windows); split-half 1.71 ± 0.08 across window sizes from 1,500 to 15,000 fourfold sites (1.60 to 1.85); eliminated π0/π4 lies 0.116 above the retained trend extrapolated to its own π4 (z = 3.03, P = 0.0025)
verdict: Partly supported: accounts for less than half of the elevation (at most 42%)

prediction: Retained genes near a breakage region share its local environment and should also show elevated πN/πS
test: Retained genes within 150 kb of a CBR compared with interior retained genes, and with eliminated genes
result: Near-CBR retained genes have 41% lower πS but indistinguishable πN/πS (difference −0.003, 95% CI −0.025 to +0.021); eliminated genes are 2.13-fold higher than near-CBR retained genes (95% CI 1.76 to 2.58)

prediction: Diversity is lowest in the largest tracts, where recombination is rarest (background selection)
test: Spearman correlation between πS and eliminated tract size
result: ρ = +0.21, P = 6 × 10⁻⁴: πS rises with tract size, opposite to the prediction

alternative: Reference bias (A. lumbricoides reads mapped to the A. suum assembly)
prediction: Reads from divergent haplotypes map less well, distorting diversity most where divergence from the reference is greatest
test: Reference-allele fraction at heterozygous calls and homozygous-alternate genotype rate by region; πN/πS contrast within strata of local divergence
result: Reference-allele fraction at heterozygous calls 0.553 against 0.528, the same difference before the allele-balance screen; homozygous-alternate rate lower in eliminated regions (ratio 0.88); contrast 1.8- to 2.5-fold in every stratum with enough eliminated sites to estimate, largest at sites with no other variant within 150 bp

prediction: The weighting of partially degenerate sites, not selection, produces the contrast
test: π0/π4 from strictly zero-fold and fourfold degenerate sites
result: 1.82-fold (95% CI 1.59 to 2.10), within 4% of the πN/πS contrast (1.88-fold)

test: Genotype discordance between every pair of libraries
result: The most similar pair disagrees at 21.6% of genotype calls, against 1% to 2% expected for one worm sequenced twice

prediction: The contrast depends on a single worm
test: πN/πS contrast recomputed with each worm held out in turn
result: 1.859 to 1.902, against 1.887 for all ten worms in the same computation (jackknife standard error over individuals 0.036)

prediction: Libraries from one sequencing batch, or with excess eliminated heterozygosity, produce the contrast
test: The three libraries of one sequencing batch removed together; the two libraries whose eliminated heterozygosity exceeds their retained heterozygosity removed together
result: 1.892 and 1.888, against 1.887 for all ten worms in the same computation
